candidate.hadamard_family_endpoint: abs(angle_pi)=0.25 gives a dense signed-Hadamard member
candidate.parameterization: four H16-wired Givens stages with one shared scalar angle
candidate.rotation: one layer-shared 16x16 FP32 SO butterfly repeated over 128 middle K16 blocks and 288 experts
candidate.runtime_precision: FP32 table validated, then cast to served BF16 by current Humming hook
candidate.scope: down-only; gate/up remain bitwise carrier NVFP4

claim_boundary: train/tune are fit-role adaptive evidence; conditional-fit32 is already-open development evidence; selection, confirmation, final, and reserved confirmation logits remain unopened

controls.rotation_attribution: angle_pi=0 encoded by the identical full-GPTQ down-only path

encoder.format: ModelOpt NVFP4 E2M1 plus E4M3-per-16 and FP32 tensor scale
encoder.method: full-Hessian GPTQ with static native-group order
encoder.objective: actual packed down operator under routed fit activations

falsification: no nonzero angle beats both the matched zero-angle full-GPTQ control and stock ModelOpt NVFP4 on tune32 mean causal KLD
hypothesis: a compact layer-shared partial butterfly on the down input can retain the down-family signal without incompatible block-specific bases
observation: V6 forced block-local H16 and V7 identity-selective block H16 both improved their local surrogate but worsened end-to-end KLD
role: adaptive fit-only KLD search followed by already-open conditional-fit32

runtime.fusion_status: not fused; native prologue work is gated on KLD win

search.conditional_fit_rule: after tune pass, freeze one candidate and run conditional-fit32 once; advance only if means are lower than both controls; report paired BCa
search.selection_rule: lowest finite equal-window mean KLD on train32; no NMSE substitution
search.stopping: one train32 run per nine fixed grid arms; one tune32 run per declared tune arm; no rerolls or replacements
search.training_measurement: all-vocabulary all-causal-row teacher KLD on train32
search.tune_advance_rule: selected nonzero angle must have lower tune32 mean KLD than both controls, stock delta <= -0.0004, and no domain mean delta versus stock > +0.0005; paired BCa is reported as a control but need not exclude zero
search.tune_arms: selected nonzero angle, zero-angle matched control, and stock ModelOpt control
